requiredBehaviors.behavior: represent the common information need as a shared question intent while allowing separate vendor and internal wording
requiredBehaviors.evidence: For genuine both-side clarifications the contract supports a shared questionIntent plus separate vendorWording and internalWording when role or confidentiality requires different framing.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: ask the vendor for pricing tiers and minimum commitments and ask internal stakeholders for the supportable demand range

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve confidentiality by not exposing the internal ceiling or negotiation position in vendor wording

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy the internal volume ceiling into the vendor-facing question
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill requires confidential internal information to remain out of vendor wording and allows separate vendor/internal formulations for the same question intent.
